title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: Fly. There is no romantic road-trip version of Manaus to Rio to Iguacu to Sao Paulo that fits eleven days.
Domestic flights save enormous distances but create fragility: delays, diversions and airport time accumulate. Leave buffers around anything you cannot afford to miss.
Within Rio and Sao Paulo, ride-hailing is straightforward. In the Amazon, boats become the road network.
